purpose: Teach: 売り込み/給水/消火/手掛け/綴る/祭祀/即位/レポーター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規顧客への、本気で、絶対、売り込み、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to strengthen our pitch to new clients. I'm serious about this—make it happen.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Measured pace. Each directive lands with quiet weight. No room for negotiation in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。事業所の、本気で、絶対、給水、絶対、整備、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward with the office water and utility maintenance as planned.
lines.style: Respectful, steady cadence. Slight formality in the posture of the voice. Affirmative without overstatement. Professional acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 工場の、本気で、絶対、消火、絶対、設備、絶対、点検しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want the factory fire-safety equipment inspected thoroughly. Make sure it's done.
lines.style: Direct, businesslike. Slight emphasis on 'thoroughly.' Tempo steady but urgent. The tone of someone who won't accept shortcuts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社が、本気で、絶対、手掛けて、絶対、いる新プロジェクト、絶対、業界の注目、絶対、集めております、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're also moving ahead with the new project we're handling—it's already getting attention in the industry.
lines.style: Calm, informative. Slight lift of pride on 'getting attention.' Measured delivery, like reporting progress in a meeting. Professional confidence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社内報を、本気で、絶対、綴る、絶対、担当者、絶対、決めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Someone needs to be assigned to write the company newsletter. Decide on who that's going to be.
lines.style: Decisive, clipped. Minimal elaboration. The tone of a manager delegating without doubt. Expectation baked in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域の、本気で、絶対、祭祀、絶対、当社の協賛、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're also coordinating our sponsorship of the local festival. That's moving along well.
lines.style: Even-toned, matter-of-fact. Light warmth on 'moving along well'—subtle satisfaction. Unhurried pacing, professional.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新社長の、本気で、絶対、即位、絶対、当社、絶対、お祝い、絶対、お送りしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure we send a proper congratulatory gift on behalf of the company for the new president's appointment.
lines.style: Formal, ceremonial weight. Deliberate pacing. 'Proper' and 'behalf of the company' said with clear importance. Respectful tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、レポーター、絶対、当社の取材、絶対、来ていただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. And the industry press came by for a feature on our company—that was a good sign.
lines.style: Closing confidence. Slight warmth on 'good sign.' Unhurried, reflective ending. The tone of someone wrapping up a successful briefing.
